ddl.name: campaign_period_valid_check
ddl.value: "ends_at" IS NULL OR "starts_at" IS NULL OR "ends_at" >= "starts_at"

ddl.name: campaign_bogo_valid_check
ddl.value:
"discount_type" != 'buy_n_get_m_free'
          OR (
            "buy_quantity" IS NOT NULL
            AND "free_quantity" IS NOT NULL
            AND "buy_quantity" >= 1
            AND "free_quantity" >= 1
          )

ddl.name: order_refund_items_other_reason_requires_note_check
ddl.value: "reason" != 'other' OR ("note" IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM("note")) > 0)

ddl.name: order_products_cancel_reason_required_check
ddl.value: "cancelled_at" IS NULL OR "cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: order_products_cancel_other_reason_requires_note_check
ddl.value: "cancel_reason" != 'other' OR ("cancel_note" IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM("cancel_note")) > 0)
